protocol.scope: One bounded offline diagnostic; no fitting, benchmark scoring, coefficient changes or release decision.
protocol.equation: 100 * shooting / (1 + turnovers - rebounds), where shooting=PTS/S, turnovers=TOV/S, rebounds=ORB/S, S=FGA+0.44FTA.
protocol.inputs: Frozen historical lagged player rates and target minutes; reproduce both topFive and wholeRoster projections before diagnostics.
protocol.outcomes: Pool target-season NBA team stints by games times per-game counts. Match frozen player identities, minutes and CSV lineage exactly; exclude TOT/nTM and zero-minute zero-count stints.
protocol.attribution: Six-order Shapley decomposition of predicted proxy minus observed whole-team proxy across three components. Center each attribution within the full season before cohort selection.
protocol.residual: Observed whole-team box proxy minus official ORTG, both equal-team season centered. Retain separately; never label it a player component error.
protocol.mseAttribution: Mean(component error * total official-rating error); sums to MSE with the residual. Signed covariance allocation, not independent component MSE or causal importance.
protocol.oracle: Replace one projected ratio at a time with its observed whole-team ratio; recenter each hybrid across full season. Outcome-conditioned diagnostics, NOT deployable predictions or matched causal interventions.
protocol.workload: Primary: frozen 75 possessions per36 divided by projected per36 net possessions. Sensitivity: observed target per36 net possessions divided by projected net possessions; uses outcomes, diagnostic only.
protocol.bins: Fixed workload bins <=1, (1,1.25], >1.25. No ceiling selected or penalty fitted.
protocol.association: Pearson correlation with absolute official-rating error and absolute centered component errors; also correlate season-demeaned values. Associations are descriptive, not causal load-efficiency estimates.
protocol.cohorts: Earlier1981-2012; later2013-2026; laterEarly2013-2019; laterRecent2020-2026. All teams and >=90% prior-minute coverage. No new holdout claim.
protocol.uncertainty: Normal 95% season-cluster intervals for mean covariance contributions and paired oracle MSE differences; no multiplicity correction. Small-cluster estimates are approximate.
protocol.stop: Diagnose only. No automatic component model, imputation, workload penalty or parameter search after viewing results.

limitations: Oracle results contain target outcomes and cannot be treated as prediction accuracy or gameplay improvements.
Component ratios share shot denominators; Shapley allocation is exact accounting, not causal identification.
Whole-team outcomes are the target for both representations; top-five errors include omitted reserves and equal-time assumptions.
Player-count rounding, team-only events and the box possession proxy differ from official team offense.
Workload uses projected net possession volume, not measured shot-creation capacity. The outcome-volume sensitivity is explicitly outcome-conditioned.
Source data and later seasons were previously exposed. 2026 data are used as stored. No benchmark targets are read for tuning.
